model_plan.training_population: Only original A parent opportunities for all families; within family all models share union-feature finite/ready rows. Joint has separate intersection, never mix denominators.

model_plan.keep: risk score < training-score75th percentile; equality rejects. This is fixed opportunity use diagnostic, not an account.
model_plan.joint_scope: One predeclared combined increment on common support; cannot attribute both inputs separately from combined improvement. E2 only timing counterevidence, never choose winner.

evaluation.primary: Mean paired (L-pred0)^2-(L-pred1)^2 on same A OOS rows; positive improves downside-loss forecast; coefficient/residual direction reported

evaluation.counterevidence: Per-year, without2026, filled/all-attempt, actual holding-overlap connected clusters, equal-cluster/LOO/largest-cluster removal and chronological nonoverlap; option no-roll/active-pair diagnostics
evaluation.uncertainty: paired holding-cluster bootstrap2000 draws seed13; report interval/sample/cluster counts; nominal exploratory intervals across repeated research, no multiplicity-free confirmation
evaluation.matched_participation: Retrospective same-year baseline score ordering matched to M1 retained count is a diagnostic, never a causal real-time trading rule
evaluation.classification: Supported/negative/duplicate/not applicable/insufficient data/technical failure separately judged. Conditional raw proxies and uncertain historical arrival cannot certify causal/live readiness. Prediction gain, risk use and complete strategy yearly targets are separate.
